title: IPS Officer Who Led Sushant Singh Rajput CBI Probe Awarded President's Medal
excerpt: Nupur Prasad, the CBI superintendent who led the SIT investigating Bollywood actor Sushant Singh Rajput's death, is among 21 CBI personnel honoured on India's 80th Independence Day.
body:
• IPS officer Nupur Prasad has been awarded the President's Police Medal for Distinguished Service on the occasion of India's 80th Independence Day.
  • Prasad led the CBI's Special Investigation Team that probed the death of Bollywood actor Sushant Singh Rajput in 2020, one of India's most high-profile criminal investigations.
  • A total of 21 CBI personnel were honoured with police medals this Independence Day, part of 1,090 medals awarded across police, fire, and civil defence services.
  • A 2007-batch AGMUT cadre IPS officer, Prasad was empanelled to the rank of Inspector General in 2025.

IPS officer Nupur Prasad, who led the Central Bureau of Investigation's probe into the death of Bollywood actor Sushant Singh Rajput, has been awarded the President's Police Medal for Distinguished Service on the occasion of India's 80th Independence Day, according to India Today and NDTV.

Prasad is among 21 CBI personnel honoured with police medals this year, as part of a total of 1,090 gallantry and service medals announced by the Ministry of Home Affairs for police, fire, home guard, civil defence, and correctional services personnel.

The Sushant Singh Rajput Investigation

Prasad's name became nationally prominent in August 2020 when she was appointed to lead the CBI's Special Investigation Team investigating the death of Sushant Singh Rajput. The 34-year-old actor was found dead at his Bandra apartment in Mumbai on June 14, 2020, in a case that gripped the nation and triggered an intense public debate over the circumstances of his death.

As Superintendent of Police, Prasad led the SIT that arrived in Mumbai on August 20, 2020, following the Supreme Court's order directing a CBI probe. She organized the investigation into multiple specialized teams: one to collect forensic evidence, another to interrogate key witnesses including the actor's flatmate Siddharth Pithani and cook Neeraj, a third to recreate the death scene at the Mont Blanc apartment in Bandra, and additional teams to examine CCTV footage and liaise with Mumbai Police, according to Livemint and IANS reports.

The CBI had registered a case against Rajput's girlfriend Rhea Chakraborty, her family members, and others based on a complaint filed by the actor's father K.K. Singh with Bihar Police.

A Distinguished Career

Prasad, a 2007-batch IPS officer from the AGMUT (Arunachal Pradesh-Goa-Mizoram-Union Territory) cadre, was inducted into the CBI at the SP level in July 2019 through a formal deputation order from the Ministry of Home Affairs. Before joining the CBI, she served as DCP in Delhi, where she earned recognition for her work on drug trafficking and women's safety cases, according to the Jharkhand Gyan profile.

In May 2025, she was empanelled to the rank of Inspector General in the Government of India, according to Witness in the Corridors, a bureaucracy news publication. She has most recently served as Joint Commissioner of Police (Licensing) with Delhi Police.

Independence Day Medal Tally

The Ministry of Home Affairs announced a total of 1,090 medals for Independence Day 2026, comprising 233 gallantry medals, 99 President's Medals for Distinguished Service, and 758 medals for meritorious service. The highest number of gallantry medals went to personnel from Jammu and Kashmir, followed by the Central Reserve Police Force and the Border Security Force, according to Blitz India Media.

Among the 21 CBI personnel honoured, Prasad received one of the most prestigious recognitions — the President's Police Medal for Distinguished Service — awarded for exceptional records in service. Seventeen Delhi Police officers were also awarded medals on the occasion, according to The Times of India.

What's Next

The President's Medal adds to Prasad's growing list of accomplishments as one of the CBI's most recognized officers. Her career trajectory — from Delhi Police to the CBI's most scrutinized investigation and now to an IG-level empanelment — reflects the kind of recognition that high-profile case leadership can bring within India's police services.
